name: Mujaddara
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer with 700 ml water for 15–20 minutes until partly tender but still holding their shape. Drain, reserving the liquid.
Thinly slice onions and cook in oil over medium-low heat for 25–35 minutes, stirring often, until deeply caramelized but not burnt. Reserve one-third for topping.
Rinse rice and add to remaining onions with cumin, lentils, salt and pepper. Stir gently for 1 minute.
Measure 650 ml of reserved lentil liquid plus fresh water as needed and add to the pan. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low heat for 15–18 minutes.
Check that both rice and lentils are tender, adding a little boiling water if needed. Turn off heat and rest covered for 10 minutes.
Fluff gently, top with reserved onions and serve warm.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
